parameters.content:
## WORKFLOW 1
# 🧠 AI RECRUITMENT INTELLIGENCE SYSTEM v3
Owned By: Ronny Kalaksanan
Last Updated: 2026-08-16 (v3.0 — custom briefing service on Vercel)
Description: CV upload → extract & mask PII → screen vs requirements → log → [if shortlisted] GitHub enrichment (cached) → interviewer briefing (custom Node.js/Express service on Vercel, with Zod validation + differentiated retry logic) → update sheet & notify.

Dependencies:
- Groq API (screening + CV extraction, model llama-3.3-70b-versatile / llama-3.1-8b-instant)
- Google Sheets OAuth2 (main log + "GitHub Cache" tab)
- Gmail OAuth2 (interview invitation)
- Custom briefing service: github.com/ronnykalaksanan/recruitai-automation (folder briefing-service/), deployed on Vercel, calls Groq API directly with structured JSON output + Zod validation + retry logic separated by failure type (JSON invalid / field mismatch / API failure)
- Environment variables on Vercel: GROQ_API_KEY, SERVICE_API_KEY (required in HTTP Request node's x-api-key header)

⚠️ SETUP TODO before running:
(1) create "GitHub Cache" tab in the spreadsheet, reselect it in CheckGithubCache and WriteGithubCache nodes (placeholder value used here)
(2) add columns to main log: Candidate ID, GitHub Username, GitHub Tech Stack, GitHub Last Activity, Interviewer Discrepancy Notes, Suggested Follow-up Questions, Verification Risk Score
(3) set GITHUB_TOKEN env var in n8n once you have a PAT
(4) add Header Auth to ReceiveCvUpload webhook
(5) create Global ErrorHandler workflow
(6) set GROQ_API_KEY and SERVICE_API_KEY as environment variables on Vercel project (recruitai-automation, Root Directory: briefing-service)
(7) update HTTP Request node's URL to match your own Vercel deployment domain

## 🚀 FUTURE IMPROVEMENTS

1. MULTI JOB POSTING
   - Frontend currently only shows data[0] from sheet
   - Need: job selector dropdown OR job_id in URL param
   - Backend: filter by job_id, not just "active" status

2. CANDIDATE DATABASE
   - Currently only logs to Sheets (good for demo, not scalable)
   - Upgrade to: Airtable / Supabase / PostgreSQL for larger volume

3. DUPLICATE APPLICATION CHECK
   - No check if same candidate applies twice for same job
   - Add: email + job_id uniqueness validation

4. OCR SUPPORT
   - Current "Extract from File" only works on text-based PDF
   - Scanned/image CVs will fail
   - Upgrade: add OCR node (e.g. Google Vision API) as fallback

5. HR DASHBOARD
   - No way to view all candidates in one place currently
   - Build: simple admin frontend to view/filter/export candidates

6. INTERVIEW SCHEDULING
   - "Reply to schedule interview" is manual right now
   - Upgrade: integrate Calendly/Google Calendar for auto-booking

7. RATE LIMITING / SPAM PROTECTION
   - Webhook is public, no protection against spam submissions
   - Add: simple captcha or submission rate limit

8. MULTI-LANGUAGE SUPPORT
   - Currently English-only prompts and emails
   - Could detect CV language and respond accordingly

## 🔍 GITHUB ENRICHMENT (v2)
Runs ONLY for shortlisted candidates.
Cache TTL: 30 days, keyed by github_username.
Unauthenticated by default (60 req/hr) -- set .GITHUB_TOKEN once you generate a PAT to raise the limit to 5000/hr.
Manifest check covers: pyproject.toml, composer.json, package.json across top 5 repos.

## 📥 ENTRY POINT
Receives PDF CV + position + requirements from the frontend (multipart/form-data). Field name: "cv" for the file.

🔐 Protected by Header Auth (X-API-Key) -- filters out random bots/scrapers.

## 📄 PDF PROCESSING
ExtractTextFromPdf: converts the uploaded PDF into raw text.
PrepareExtractedData: pulls position & requirements out of the webhook body into clean fields for downstream nodes.

## 🛡️ PII PROTECTION
DetectAndMaskPii (Code node): regex-detects email & phone BEFORE anything reaches the LLM. Redacts them from cv_text -> cv_text_masked.
Also generates candidate_id here (unique key used later to update the right Sheet row after GitHub enrichment).

## 🧠 AI EXTRACTION
ExtractCandidateData (Information Extractor) reads the MASKED cv text and pulls out structured fields: name, skills, experience, education, etc.
Uses Llama-3.1-8b-Instant -- small/fast model, right-sized because this is an extraction task, not complex reasoning.
Email & phone are NOT extracted here anymore -- they come from the regex step instead (more reliable + less PII sent to the LLM).

## ⚖️ AI SCREENING
ScreenAndMatchRequirements compares the candidate's extracted profile against the job's position/requirements, produces an AI Score + Recommendation (Shortlist / Hold / Reject).
Uses Llama-3.3-70b-Versatile -- larger model, needed here because this is actual reasoning/judgment, not simple extraction.

## 💾 LOG & ROUTE
LogCandidateToSheet: writes the candidate row FIRST (before any notification goes out -- SOP rule: save before notify).
RouteByRecommendation (IF): checks if Recommendation contains "SHORTLIST". TRUE -> GitHub Enrichment branch. FALSE -> straight to rejection email.

## ❌ REJECT PATH
SendRejectionNotice: sends the standard rejection email. No GitHub API calls happen for this path -- saves quota for candidates who won't move forward anyway.

## 🔍 GITHUB ENRICHMENT -- Cache Check
Runs ONLY for shortlisted candidates.
ExtractGithubUsername: regex-parses github.com/username from the CV text.
CheckGithubCache: looks up that username in the "GitHub Cache" sheet tab (Always Output Data ON -- so an empty result doesn't kill the branch).
EvaluateGithubCache: decides if a hit is fresh (TTL 30 days).
IsGithubCacheFresh (IF): fresh cache -> use it as-is. Otherwise -> fetch live from GitHub.

## 🌐 GITHUB ENRICHMENT -- Live Fetch
FetchGithubEnrichmentLive (Code node): calls GitHub API for user profile, top 5 repos, language breakdown per repo, and checks for pyproject.toml / composer.json / package.json. Wrapped in retry-with-backoff for transient failures (404s are NOT retried -- they just mean "not present").
Uses this.helpers.httpRequest (NOT fetch() -- not available in n8n Code node sandbox).
WriteGithubCache: saves the result back to the cache sheet for next time.

## 📝 INTERVIEWER BRIEFING (v2 — custom service)
GenerateInterviewerBriefingV2: HTTP Request node yang manggil service Node.js/Express custom (deployed di Vercel), bukan n8n AI node bawaan lagi. Compares CV claims vs GitHub evidence, produces discrepancy_summary + suggested_questions + overall_risk_score (0-100).

Alasan upgrade: n8n informationExtractor node tidak punya validasi ketat & retry granular. Service custom ini pakai validasi Zod + retry logic yang dibedakan 3 jenis kegagalan (JSON invalid / field salah tipe / API gagal) untuk hasil yang lebih reliable.

UseCachedGithubData: tetap jadi sumber input CV+GitHub data seperti sebelumnya.
ReattachGithubData: Information Extractor nodes don't auto-carry prior fields, so this re-attaches github_enrichment before it's needed for the Sheet write.
UpdateSheetWithBriefing: updates the SAME row with discrepancy notes, suggested questions, DAN kolom baru Verification Risk Score.

Service repo: github.com/ronnykalaksanan/recruitai-automation (folder briefing-service/)
Service endpoint: https://recruitai-automation.vercel.app/generate-briefing

## 📤 RESPOND TO FRONTEND
FormatResponseForFrontend + RespondToFrontend.
⚠️ IMPORTANT: for the Interview path, this is wired directly off RouteByRecommendation (branches in parallel with GitHub Enrichment) so the browser gets a fast response WITHOUT waiting for GitHub API calls + briefing generation, which can take 20-40+ seconds. Those continue running in the background after the response is already sent.
